# Just Go

> Sales and business development consultancy based in Zagreb, Croatia, working
> with clients worldwide in English and Croatian.

Just Go is run by Berislav Sokač (Founder & CEO) and Odin Sokač (Co-Founder,
Brand & Creative). Berislav spent eleven years at Oracle, ending as sales
director for the Baltic countries and Central & Eastern Europe, then co-founded
Run Croatia in 2015 — roughly 120 events in ten years, including Zagreb Advent
Run, the largest race of its kind in Europe. Odin is a blues musician who
represented Croatia at the 2024 International Blues Challenge in Memphis.

The firm's thesis: most sales problems are not strategy problems, they are
starting problems — the call nobody made, the price nobody raised, the
partnership nobody asked for.

## Services

Three defined engagements:

- **Sales Strategy & Go-to-Market Design** — for founders and CEOs whose growth
  has stalled or who are entering a new market. Typically 8–14 weeks.
- **Sales Team Enablement** — pipeline discipline, qualification and negotiation
  for teams that are busy but not closing. Typically 6–16 weeks.
- **Partnerships & Sponsorship Development** — packaging, pricing, outreach and
  renewal for organisations that need corporate partners or sponsors.
  Typically 3–9 months.

Industries known deeply: financial services; retail and hospitality;
telecommunications and utilities; government and transportation.

## Working with Just Go

- Fixed scope, fixed fee, agreed in writing before work starts. Not hourly.
- Remote-first from Zagreb (Central European Time), worldwide, with travel for
  kickoffs, negotiations and team sessions.
- First call is 30 minutes, free, with no obligation.
- Contact is by form or email; messages are answered the same working day.
